symbols.name: position index
symbols.meaning: The position of a coefficient in the list, counted from 0 at the least significant end.
symbols.quote: Here $m$ is the position index: it counts the positions of the list from $0$ at the least significant end.

symbols.name: radix
symbols.meaning: The number $2^b$ of values a digit can take.
symbols.quote: The radix is $Q_0 = 2^b$, the number of values a digit can take, so each digit is a $b$-bit block.

symbols.name: output digit
symbols.meaning: The digit of the binary output at position $m$, an integer from 0 to $Q_0-1$.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma_m$ be the output digit at position $m$, which lies in $\{0, \dots, Q_0-1\}$.

symbols.name: carry
symbols.meaning: The amount carried into position $m$ from the lower positions.
symbols.quote: Let $\gamma_m$ be the carry into position $m$, the amount carried from the lower positions.

symbols.name: summation index
symbols.meaning: The index running over the positions below $m$ in the sums of the invariant.
symbols.quote: Here $h$ is the summation index, running over the positions below $m$.

relations.quote: Carry propagation takes its input from [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md).
Carry propagation takes its digit width from the [base-2 logarithm](base-two-logarithm.md) of $n$: $b = \lceil \log_2 n \rceil$.
Carry propagation computes its digit count by the [ceiling function](ceiling-function.md): $J = \lceil n/b \rceil$.
